critical_code_review_comments: sync.php:419-522 save_dataset_cache — Static review CLEAN. Brace/paren counts balanced (9/9, 40/40). Function order: paramsHash calc → SELECT existing → NEW UNCONDITIONAL GUARD (lines 437-445) for rap_filtre_lookup+row_count<=0 (returns skipped_empty_overwrite BEFORE any writes; handles both branches: existing-row returns id, no-row returns 0/0) → normal UPDATE/INSERT branches → dataset_snapshots UPDATE/INSERT → update_existing_requests_from_cache → return array. Guard fires ONLY for rap_filtre_lookup so no regression for other datasets (fis_gunluk_bildirim_feed, extre_fis, etc.).

sync.php:440-445 guard — Correctly checks $rowCount which is derived by normalize_row_count($data) at line 426. Both count([]) and count of empty arrays are 0, so [] payload correctly triggers skip. Guard runs UNCONDITIONALLY (no `if ($existing)` gating) which closes the previous defense-in-depth gap for brand-new tenants. Returns short-circuit prevents snapshot write and sync_requests update — which is the desired behavior (no snapshot revision bump on ignored payload).

backend/routes/data.py:3073-3141 (unchanged since iter14) — _RAP_DENY set correctly prevents POS on-demand fallthrough for rap_filtre_lookup; missing-cache path returns empty data list gracefully.
